title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 12/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII. Set up inside SBD perimeter area for 1st Set, mics moved onto SBD platform for 2nd Set, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Phenomenal soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with a blazing Playing in the Band → Crazy Fingers opener and a powerful Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a master‑class, community‑sourced soundboard tape that delivers crystal‑clear audio throughout. Musically the concert bursts into life from an electrifying Playing in the Band into Crazy Fingers segue and sustains its momentum with a heartfelt Touch of Grey, leaving listeners feeling they’ve experienced the essence of a Dead show.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights both an exceptional performance and top‑tier recording quality, driving the rating near the top of the scale but confidence is low due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a master recording with community effort and second‑set mics on an SBD platform, indicating very clear and balanced sound.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Crazy Fingers
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening that 'takes off' and maintains high energy through the set, praised for seamless transitions.
